messages.subject: Errors Running RSelenium on ShinyApps.io
parts:
I'm having trouble running a shiny app I created on ShinyApps.io.

The app uses the RSelenium package to go to a website, navigate the page, enter some information, and return the results. The Shiny app works fine when I run it via Rstudio on my local computer, however once I uploaded the app it errors out.

These are the error messages from the log:

Is there any way for me to use RSelenium within an app on ShinyApps.io? 

Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Errors Running RSelenium on ShinyApps.io
parts:
Devin,

FireFix is not installed. You might be able to use Selenium's headless browser mode, but I am not sure if this will work for you or not depending on your use case.

-Andy
